# NYC Kindred History

A short timeline of the Kindred of New York as this chronicle tells it. Dates before 1990 are hazy on purpose: the elders who remember them lie.

- 1600s: the first Kindred arrive with the Dutch. The Fenwick Street tunnels are already there, which no one can explain.
- 1800s: the city grows faster than any one clan can hold it. The Nosferatu dig in below while the Ventrue buy everything above.
- 1900 to 1980: decades of unstable rule, several short-lived Princes, and a reputation as a city no sect can keep.
- 1980s: the Sabbat drive the Camarilla out. The Masquerade frays badly.
- 1999: the Camarilla retakes the city in a long campaign. [[Calebros]] accepts the Princedom as a caretaker because no one else is trusted by every clan.
- 2000: the Primogen council is reformed. [[Marleina]] begins building her majority. The Tremere reopen the Ashgrove Chantry under [[Hakim Olamaz]].
- Spring 2001: the first Kindred disappears in the lower tunnels. The Nosferatu close the deep stairs and do not say why.
- Summer 2001: Calebros announces that he will step down before the end of the year.
- September 2001: [[Rene Valentine]] sends out the invitations to the autumn masquerade. The chronicle opens.
